stem.text: The effect of substrate concentration on an enzyme-catalysed reaction was measured in three different conditions:

stem.alt: Graph of rate of reaction against substrate concentration with three curves: enzyme with no inhibitor, inhibitor X and inhibitor Y.

A.text: X is a competitive inhibitor which binds to a site other than the active site of the enzyme.

B.text: X is a non-competitive inhibitor which has a similar shape to the active site of the enzyme.

C.text: Y is a competitive inhibitor which has a similar shape to the active site of the enzyme.

D.text: Y is a non-competitive inhibitor which binds to a site other than the active site of the enzyme.
